title: Mediterranean Diet in Familial Mediterranean Fever: Is Fatty Liver Affected by Addition of Aerobic Exercise
off: Mediterranean Diet in Familial Mediterranean Fever: Is Fatty Liver Affected by Addition of Elliptical Aerobic Exercise
summary: Familial Mediterranean fever (FMF) affect liver and causes some dysfunctions including non-alcoholic fatty liver.. still exercise and diet limitation is the treatment for this case
desc: Familial Mediterranean fever (FMF women with fatty liver) will be collected to be cateogarized to group I or group II. Every group OF FMF will contain 20 FMF women. Both groups will follow their colchicine (traditional daily drug therapy for FMF) in addition to Mediterranean diet for six months. Group I will also perform elliptical aerobic exercise (this exercise will be applied for 40 minutes three times weekly and this exercise will be maintained for 6 months)
